# PR type
- [x] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

<!-- No existing GitHub issue tracks this; a descriptive issue can be opened before submission if preferred. -->

`glm4_5`/`glm4_7`/`glm5_1`, `flint`, `ling3`, `spark2_5` and `seed_oss` render non-string tool arguments
with `json.dumps` (mirroring their chat templates' `tojson` filter), so an integer reaches the wire as
`3` and a boolean as `false`, while strings are written raw. Their parsers returned every
`<arg_value>`/`<parameter>` text as a stripped string, so a format/parse round-trip changed
`{'retries': 3}` into `{'retries': '3'}` and `{'dry_run': False}` into `{'dry_run': 'false'}`.
`swift deploy` / inference engines and GRPO rollout parsing consume `get_toolcall` output, so tools
received wrongly-typed arguments (e.g. an `integer` field holding `"3"`).

This gives these templates the same schema-aware discrimination `xing4_0`/`minicpm5` already use
(`supports_tool_schema = True`, `get_toolcall(response, tools)`):

- a shared `BaseAgentTemplate._is_string_param` helper keeps the raw text when the declared type
  includes `'string'`; a bare `null` on a `["string", "null"]` parameter still decodes to JSON null;
- every other value is decoded with the existing `_parse_json` (with the `json.loads('null')`-vs-failure
  distinction), so integers, booleans, numbers, arrays, objects and null round-trip exactly;
- without a schema the literal decoding still applies, matching `xing4_0`/`minicpm5` semantics.

Related open PRs, different templates (no file overlap beyond `base.py`): #10462 fixes the opposite
direction for `hy_v3`/`minimax_*` (they over-decode string-typed values), #10267 covers
`qwen3_coder`/`qwen3_5`. Together the three PRs make all unquoted-wire templates schema-aware.

## Experiment results

New regression test `tests/general/test_agent_template_schema_arg_types.py` (77 parametrized cases:
typed round-trip, string-kept-verbatim adversarial values, nullable-`null`, no-schema decoding, and a
no-tool-call guard, over all 7 template keys):

```
# on clean main (red):
python -m pytest tests/general/test_agent_template_schema_arg_types.py -q
77 failed in 10.05s

# with this change (green):
python -m pytest tests/general/test_agent_template_schema_arg_types.py -q
77 passed in 10.55s
```

A round-trip fuzzer over all 37 registered agent templates (12 argument cases each) confirms the change
is surgical: 213 failures before, 142 after; the 71 fixed cases belong exactly to the 7 targeted
templates, with 0 new failures and no behavior change in any other template (their remaining failures
are the known `react_*` repr rendering and `hy_v3`/`minimax`/`qwen3_coder` issues covered by the PRs
above).

Existing template tests show no regressions:

```
python -m pytest tests/general/test_agent_template_schema_arg_types.py \
    tests/general/test_agent_template_tool_arg_types.py tests/general/test_glm4_5_agent_template.py -q
115 passed, 53 subtests passed

python -m pytest tests/general/test_qwen3_coder_agent_template.py tests/general/test_xing4_0_template.py \
    tests/general/test_deepseek_v41_template.py tests/test_align/test_template/test_agent.py -q
48 passed / 23 failed — identical on clean main (pre-existing vllm-dependent NameErrors in the env)
```

Lint (pinned versions from `.pre-commit-config.yaml` / `setup.cfg`): `flake8` (max-line-length 120,
`select=B,C,E,F,P,T4,W,B9`), `isort==8.0.1 --check-only`, `yapf==0.43.0 --diff` — all clean on the 7
changed files.

**AI assistance disclosure:** this change was prepared with AI assistance (branch `fix/agent-template-schema-arg-types`,
commit `503e2c1a2`); every changed line has been reviewed and the tests above were run locally by the submitter.

- [ ] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [x] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [ ] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+"""Schema-aware argument typing for templates with an unquoted wire format.
+
+``glm4_5`` / ``glm4_7`` / ``glm5_1`` / ``flint`` / ``ling3`` / ``spark2_5`` /
+``seed_oss`` render non-string arguments with ``json.dumps`` (mirroring their
+chat templates' ``tojson`` filter), so an integer reaches the wire as ``3`` and
+a boolean as ``false``, while strings are written raw. Their parsers must use
+the tool schema to tell the two apart: a value whose declared type includes
+``string`` is kept verbatim, every other value is decoded as a JSON literal,
+and a bare ``null`` on a nullable string is decoded as JSON null. Without a
+schema the literal decoding still applies, matching ``xing4_0`` / ``minicpm5``.
+"""
+import json
+import pytest
+
+from swift.agent_template import agent_template_map
+
+TEMPLATES = ['glm4_5', 'glm4_7', 'glm5_1', 'flint', 'ling3', 'spark2_5', 'seed_oss']
+
+# Values that look like JSON literals but are declared (non-nullable) strings.
+STRING_CASES = ['false', 'true', '123', '1.5', '{"a": 1}', '[1, 2]', 'null']
+
+TOOLS = [{
+    'type': 'function',
+    'function': {
+        'name': 'run_job',
+        'description': 'Run a job',
+        'parameters': {
+            'type': 'object',
+            'properties': {
+                'task': {
+                    'type': 'string'
+                },
+                'retries': {
+                    'type': 'integer'
+                },
+                'dry_run': {
+                    'type': 'boolean'
+                },
+                'ratio': {
+                    'type': 'number'
+                },
+                'tags': {
+                    'type': 'array',
+                    'items': {
+                        'type': 'string'
+                    }
+                },
+                'options': {
+                    'type': 'object'
+                },
+                'note': {
+                    'type': ['string', 'null']
+                },
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}]
+
+
+def _roundtrip(template, arguments, tools=TOOLS):
+    agent = agent_template_map[template]()
+    content = json.dumps({'name': 'run_job', 'arguments': arguments}, ensure_ascii=False)
+    response = agent._format_tool_calls([{'role': 'tool_call', 'content': content}])
+    functions = agent.get_toolcall(response, tools)
+    assert len(functions) == 1, f'[{template}] response not parsed as one call: {response!r}'
+    assert functions[0].name == 'run_job'
+    # Function.__post_init__ json-dumps non-str arguments, so this is always a JSON string.
+    return json.loads(functions[0].arguments)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('template', TEMPLATES)
+def test_typed_arguments_survive_roundtrip(template):
+    arguments = {
+        'task': 'index_items',
+        'retries': 3,
+        'dry_run': False,
+        'ratio': 0.5,
+        'tags': ['a', 'b'],
+        'options': {
+            'deep': True
+        },
+        'note': None,
+    }
+    assert _roundtrip(template, arguments) == arguments
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('template', TEMPLATES)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('value', STRING_CASES)
+def test_string_arguments_are_kept_verbatim(template, value):
+    # The schema declares `task` a plain string, so literal-looking text must survive.
+    assert _roundtrip(template, {'task': value}) == {'task': value}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('template', TEMPLATES)
+def test_nullable_string_bare_null_decodes_to_none(template):
+    # A bare `null` on a ["string", "null"] parameter is ambiguous on the wire;
+    # like xing4_0/minicpm5, decode it as JSON null.
+    assert _roundtrip(template, {'note': 'null'}) == {'note': None}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('template', TEMPLATES)
+def test_no_schema_still_decodes_literals(template):
+    arguments = {'task': 'index_items', 'retries': 3, 'dry_run': True, 'note': None}
+    assert _roundtrip(template, arguments, tools=None) == arguments
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('template', TEMPLATES)
+def test_response_without_tool_call_yields_no_functions(template):
+    agent = agent_template_map[template]()
+    assert agent.get_toolcall('The weather is sunny today.', TOOLS) == []
